categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in electronic components manufacturing, computer and peripheral equipment manufacturing, wired communication machinery, cable manufacturing, mold manufacturing, hardware wholesale, chemical product wholesale, machinery equipment manufacturing, international trade, wireless communication equipment manufacturing, telecommunication RF equipment manufacturing, and medical device retail and wholesale. Its main product categories include electronic components (60%) and consumer electronics and computer peripherals (40%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cable manufacturing technologies including automotive low-voltage and high-voltage harnesses, medical consumables and instrument cables, industrial control cables, and high-density interconnect (HDI) PCB production. It employs automated SMT production lines, integrates industrial 4.0 concepts, and applies rigorous quality control and environmental management systems such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 13485, and ISO 14001. The production processes include copper wire drawing, extrusion, assembly, and PCB manufacturing with traditional and HDI boards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include companies in automotive, medical, industrial control, consumer electronics, communication, and cloud computing sectors. Major markets served are China, Hong Kong, Malaysia, the United States, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia. The company targets OEMs requiring customized cable assemblies, PCBs, and electronic manufacturing services, with a focus on automotive electronics, medical devices, industrial automation, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities primarily in Taiwan, China (including multiple factories in Dongguan, Yantai, Jiangxi, and Wuhu), Malaysia, Thailand, the United States, and Southeast Asia. Sales are concentrated in China (36%), Hong Kong (18%), Taiwan (13%), Malaysia (12%), the United States (8%), Singapore (7%), and other regions (6%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of electronic components, cable harnesses, and PCBs. It also provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) as a contract manufacturer, integrating upstream raw materials from suppliers and delivering finished components and assemblies downstream to OEMs and end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding automotive product revenue, especially EV-related harnesses and PCBs, enhancing R&D capabilities with a focus on high-frequency, high-speed cables, medical and industrial applications, and smart manufacturing automation. The company invests about 1.5-2% of revenue in R&D annually, developing new products such as EV high-voltage cables, medical consumables, mining machine PCBs, server PCBs, and automotive optical boards. Sustainability and ESG initiatives, including carbon reduction and green energy use, are also key focus areas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic components, cable assemblies, PCBs, and contract manufacturing services (EMS). The company also earns from strategic alliances and potential acquisitions in automotive product lines. Revenue is derived from both direct sales to OEM customers and through global supply chain partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly competitive global electronics manufacturing and cable assembly market, facing intense price competition especially from Chinese manufacturers. It positions itself as a technology-driven, quality-focused supplier with certifications in automotive and medical sectors, leveraging its global footprint and diversified product portfolio to maintain competitiveness. The company aims to differentiate through innovation, high-value product development, and expanding automotive and medical market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$21.8 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 15% decline from the previous year, with a gross margin improvement to 13.51%. Net profit margin was 5.51%, with a return on equity of 7.29%. Total assets were about NT$24.6 billion, and equity totaled NT$16.5 billion. Despite recent revenue declines due to market and geopolitical challenges, the company maintains a stable financial position with ongoing investments in capacity and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its ability to provide customized, high-quality cable harnesses and PCBs tailored to automotive, medical, industrial, and consumer electronics applications. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing technologies, comprehensive quality certifications, strong R&D capabilities, and a global operational footprint that supports flexible production and supply chain resilience. Commitment to ESG and sustainability further enhances its corporate image and customer trust.
